item.title: Find old versions: Apple (multiple products): Improper Authentication
item.description:
Apple (multiple products): Authentication bypass · low-privileged account · local access · exploited · fix: 17.5, 16.7.8, 14.5

First step: This flaw dates from 2024, but CISA only now lists it as exploited. Find any system that still runs an affected version of the affected Apple products, and update or retire it.

Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

Medium · Fix available · CVE-2024-27834
